purpose: Make Part I regions visually readable at a glance through dominant silhouette/vista anchors while preserving low-spec performance and chapter gates.
global_rules: Every production region owns at least one dominant silhouette/vista or interior focal vista used for navigation and cinematic continuity.
Landmark identity comes from composition, silhouette, material family, lighting/fog state and traversal framing before raw polygon density.
Critical landmark visibility must survive Low/Medium 720p target presentation.
Repeated dressing around landmarks uses ISM/HISM and LOD/culling.
Heavy landmark assets remain soft-referenced and asynchronously streamed.
Critical next-area vista data should be preloaded before the player reaches a transition.
Landmark planning never unlocks a downstream runtime chapter before predecessor Gate 6/7 acceptance.

regions.identity_anchor: Pastoral hill and Hobbit-hole/circular-door garden vista
regions.visibility_goal: Readable as a warm low-threat domestic landscape from traversal approaches.
Interior composition remains immediately recognizable without depending on dense prop count alone.

regions.identity_anchor: Town-gate approach framed toward timber/stone inn district
regions.visibility_goal: Arrival silhouette remains readable through rain/night states.

regions.identity_anchor: Ancient stone ring silhouette against exposed skyline
regions.visibility_goal: Ruined hilltop reads from approach and remains the cinematic horizon anchor.

regions.identity_anchor: Layered terrace and waterfall valley vista
regions.visibility_goal: Vertical layered sanctuary composition reads before fine architectural detail.
Primary ridge/pass direction remains readable under storm escalation without high-frequency clutter.

regions.identity_anchor: Monumental entrance/hall axis with state-specific tomb-alert and escape focal vistas
regions.visibility_goal: Scale and direction are readable through silhouette, columns/arches, lighting hierarchy and negative space.

regions.identity_anchor: Vertical flet and ancient tree-canopy sanctuary vista
regions.visibility_goal: The sanctuary reads as elevated, luminous and protected before fine foliage density or prop detail.

regions.identity_anchor: River-axis framed by cliffs and ancient stone monuments toward the Amon Hen approach
regions.visibility_goal: Boat-route direction and destination approach remain readable from the river without executing the later F1-08 Fellowship-break set piece.

regions.identity_anchor: Amon Hen ancient high-seat/stone-route focal vista above the Parth Galen river shore
regions.visibility_goal: The hill, ancient stone route/watchwork and river relationship remain readable across calm, attack and aftermath states while combat routes never erase the canonical landmark hierarchy.

acceptance_boundary: Source/visual identity planning only. No landmark is VISUALLY-ACCEPTED until chapter-specific observation evidence exists.
